content:
Hi — I have a PR that's been open for a few weeks and could use a reviewer familiar with measure theory / probability.

PR #35705: https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/35705

Adds two lemmas:

  • ENNReal.div_mul_div_cancel (Mathlib/Data/ENNReal/Inv.lean) — already approved by @Kevin Buzzard - IndepFun.of_self (Mathlib/Probability/Independence/Basic.lean) — self-independence implies a.e. constant (label: t-measure-probability)
    CI is clean (9/9 checks passing). @joneugster reviewed but noted he's not from the measure/probability area and stepped back. Would anyone be able to take a look at the IndepFun.of_self lemma in particular?

Thanks!

This PR has the label awaiting-author so it does not appear on the review queue. You need to comment
-awaiting-author
to remove the label once you have made the changes required by the reviewers.
Also please click on "Resolve conversation" for the comments that you acted on.
